The right hand closes around the apple, securing it between the thumb and opposing fingers while it remains at the shelf surface.
The right hand lifts the apple clear of the bottom shelf and raises it along the right side of the shelf structure toward the top shelf. The left hand remains open without contact.
The right hand carries the apple over the top shelf and lowers it to the shelf surface.
The right hand opens around the upright apple and begins lifting away. The apple remains resting upright on the top shelf at the last frame.
